projects.title: Finance Assistant
projects.description: An AI personal finance assistant that answers questions about your money in plain language. Built on the Vercel AI SDK as a tool-use agent: the LLM picks from ten typed, read-only tools and never does arithmetic itself, so every figure comes from a tool result and each answer shows its evidence. Demo sessions are traced end to end in Langfuse. An evaluation suite scores real models on tool selection and numeric accuracy, with an LLM as a judge grading answer quality.

projects.title: ClipLink - URL Shortener
projects.description: A modern URL shortener built as a single Astro app, using server-side rendering and React islands for high performance, backed by Postgres on Neon through Drizzle. Anyone can shorten a link, and users who sign in with Google or GitHub can also name, search, page through and delete the links they own. Features include seamless view transitions and dark and light mode support. The code is organized into deep feature modules, and its test suite runs against a real Postgres database instead of mocks, alongside Playwright end-to-end tests, ensuring reliability, maintainability, and long-term stability.
